title: anisopappus lastii subsp. welwitschii
intro: Anisopappus lastii subsp. welwitschii, commonly known as Welwitsch's Anisopappus, is a plant species belonging to the family Asteraceae. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various ailments, with reported health benefits including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Welwitsch's Anisopappus include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antipyretic activities, which can help to reduce pain and inflammation, fight infections, and lower body temperature. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
